title: Park Scene 4 — Social Play and Helping
purpose: Social play, helping, sharing and linked playground routines.

sentenceModels: The child is pushing the swing.
The children are building a sandcastle.
The child is giving the ball.
The child is putting the toy away.

adultSupport.focus: Talk about social routines, helping and what each child is doing.
expansionPrompts: What might happen next on the swing?
Can you tell the story from left to right?

visualAudit: One child pushing one child on a swing.
Two children building one sandcastle together in the sandbox.
One child giving one red ball to another child.
One child putting one toy truck into one blue basket.
One child drinking from one water bottle.
